mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies near the Verona Public Library under a Waxing Gibbous moon. For space enthusiasts, the ISS will be visible for one minute starting at 4:59 AM, rising over Mount Horeb in the west and traveling toward the northeast near the local Home Depot.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is currently offering nutritious grab and go lunch options that can be ordered in advance for pickup or dine in, alongside a home delivery service for seniors. Additionally, residents are reminded that construction continues on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, with concrete work underway and base gravel installed.

There is plenty to look forward to in Verona. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360 Thursday nights, or join Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee starting tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol this Saturday.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of dangerous driving while students were on board. The investigation ruled out alcohol as a cause, and the case remains under review.
For those with a sweet tooth, today's flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store will open its doors today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by and enjoy a scoop.
